name: The graduation letter
description: For the end of something long and hard: a look back at the whole run, a photo wall, and a letter that unlocks a year into whatever comes next.
tagline: For the end of something hard

defaults.title: You did it
defaults.openingMessage: I've been writing this one in my head for a while.
defaults.closingMessage: Whatever's next, you're ready for it. I've watched you get here.

copy.envelope.title: You did it.
copy.envelope.subtitle: I wanted to say it properly.
copy.welcome.subtitle: Congratulations. Now read the rest.
copy.timeline.title: The whole run
copy.futureLetter.title: Open this in five years
copy.closing.title: Whatever's next, you're ready for it.

content.text: Say the obvious thing first, and mean it. Then say the bit nobody else will: that you know what it cost.
Add the moments below — the year it nearly came apart belongs in there just as much as the results day.
Replace this with what they said in the worst week, when they were sure they'd fail.

memories.title: The first week
memories.description: When none of it made sense yet.

memories.title: The year it got hard
memories.description: Name it. Getting through it is the achievement, not the certificate.

memories.title: The final push
memories.description: The all-nighters and the person who brought food.

memories.title: Results
memories.description: Where you were standing when you found out.

openWhen.label: you don't know what you're doing next
openWhen.content: Nobody does. Say that, and say it kindly.

openWhen.label: the first job is harder than expected
openWhen.content: Remind them they've already done a harder thing than this.

openWhen.label: you need reminding you're capable
openWhen.content: Be specific about the evidence. Vague praise doesn't work on people who are doubting themselves.

futureLetter.title: Open this in five years
futureLetter.content: Write to them five years into whatever they chose. Tell them what you expect to be true, and that you'll be just as proud if none of it is.

finalSurprise.question: One more thing before you go out there.
finalSurprise.successMessage: That's the spirit. Go make us proud a while longer.
